instructors.name: Gavin Cook
instructors.bio: Gavin Cook has been training in Taekwondo for over 43 years and has been running Train Taekwondo Schools for 15 years. As a 5th Dan Black Belt and fully qualified TAGB instructor, Gavin has dedicated his career to helping children, juniors and families discover the life-changing benefits of martial arts. He is also a certified Ninja Skillz instructor. Under his instruction, the club has grown from a single class to a network of five locations across East Yorkshire, producing over 100 black belts.
highlights: 43 years training, 15 years running the club

faq.question: How do I join?
faq.answer: The easiest way to get started is to book a FREE taster session — your first class is completely free, no kit needed! Book online here: https://www.traintaekwondo.co.uk/membership.html — it only takes a few minutes. Or view the full class timetable at https://www.traintaekwondo.co.uk/timetable. You can also call or text Gavin on 07833 665905.

faq.question: What is Taekwondo?
faq.answer: Taekwondo is a Korean martial art known for its emphasis on kicking techniques. It is an Olympic sport and one of the world's most popular martial arts. At Train Taekwondo Schools we follow the TAGB syllabus — Europe's largest single martial arts organisation.

faq.question: How is Taekwondo different to Karate?
faq.answer: Taekwondo is Korean and focuses primarily on kicking techniques. Karate is Japanese and emphasises punching and striking. Taekwondo is also an Olympic sport and is particularly great for developing flexibility, speed and fitness.

faq.question: How old must my child be to start?
faq.answer: Children can start from age 3 with our Ninja Skillz programme. Family Taekwondo classes are suitable from age 5 upwards. Adults of any age are welcome!

faq.question: Can I train with my children?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Our Family Taekwondo classes are designed for parents and children to train side by side. The 3rd family member always trains FREE.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: For your first free session, just wear comfortable sports clothing — a t-shirt and jogging bottoms are perfect. No special kit needed. Once you join, you will need a Taekwondo dobok (training suit) available from our store.

faq.question: What do I need to bring?
faq.answer: Just yourself! No equipment, no kit needed for the first session. Come in comfortable sports clothes and we will take care of the rest.

faq.question: How fit do I need to be?
faq.answer: You do not need to be fit to start — that is what training is for! We welcome complete beginners of all fitness levels. Everyone works at their own pace.

faq.question: Do I have to be flexible?
faq.answer: Not at all! Flexibility is something you develop through training. Many students start with very little flexibility and improve dramatically over time.

faq.question: Do I have to grade for belts?
faq.answer: Grading is optional — you are never pressured to grade. Most students find working towards their next belt a great motivator. Gradings are held regularly throughout the year.

faq.question: When will I get my Black Belt?
faq.answer: The minimum training time to reach Black Belt at Train Taekwondo Schools is 5 years, though it typically takes 5-7 years of regular training. We have produced over 100 black belts since 2011.

faq.question: Do I have to enter tournaments?
faq.answer: Tournaments are completely optional. Many students never compete and simply enjoy training for fitness and confidence. The TAGB holds regular national tournaments for those who want to compete.

faq.question: How many people are in a class?
faq.answer: Ninja Skillz classes are limited to 12 students. Spectrum Skillz has a maximum of 7 students. Family Taekwondo class sizes are kept manageable to ensure quality instruction.

faq.question: Do I have to train twice a week?
faq.answer: No — once a week is absolutely fine to start. Some students train more frequently as they progress but there is no obligation.

faq.question: Can I keep my belt from a previous club?
faq.answer: If you trained at another TAGB-affiliated club, your belt grade is fully transferable. If from a non-TAGB club, Gavin will assess your level and place you at the appropriate grade.

faq.question: Do I have to stay and watch my child?
faq.answer: You are welcome to stay and watch but it is not required. Many parents drop children off and return at the end. For very young children (ages 3-4) we ask a parent to remain nearby.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Your first session is always FREE. For current membership pricing please visit https://www.traintaekwondo.co.uk or contact Gavin on 07833 665905. The 3rd family member always trains FREE on all membership packages.

faq.question: Where do I buy a training suit?
faq.answer: Training suits (doboks) and sparring equipment are available from our online store at https://www.traintaekwondo.co.uk/store

faq.question: What is the TAGB Licence?
faq.answer: The TAGB licence is an annual membership fee that registers you with Europe's largest martial arts organisation. It is required for grading and provides insurance cover. Your belt grades are nationally recognised and transferable to any TAGB club in the UK.

faq.question: What is Spectrum Skillz?
faq.answer: Spectrum Skillz is our specialist programme for children aged 7-14 who benefit from a smaller, more supportive environment. It is internationally acclaimed, uses a game-based learning approach, and has a maximum of 7 children per class. The first taster session is FREE.

faq.question: What is Ninja Skillz?
faq.answer: Ninja Skillz is our brain-based programme for children aged 3-7, co-created with child development experts. It has three tiers — Early Skillz (3-4), Basic Skillz (5-6) and Core Skillz (7+) — and builds confidence, focus, balance and coordination through fun structured classes. Limited to 12 spaces per class.

faq.question: Do you do a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes! Your first session is always completely FREE — no kit required, no commitment, no pressure. Book at https://www.traintaekwondo.co.uk/timetable or call Gavin on 07833 665905.

faq.question: What if I don't like violence?
faq.answer: Taekwondo is about discipline, respect and self-improvement — not violence. We teach self-defence skills and the wisdom to use them responsibly. Our classes are friendly, supportive and non-aggressive.

faq.question: Can I train if I am disabled?
faq.answer: We welcome students of all abilities. Please contact Gavin directly on 07833 665905 to discuss your specific needs and we will do our best to accommodate you.

membership_policies.cancellation: One month's notice required to cancel. When a cancellation request is received, the next month's payment is taken and the membership is then cancelled. The student can continue training for that final paid month.
membership_policies.freeze: One month's notice required to freeze. The next payment is taken and the account is then frozen for the agreed period.
membership_policies.cross_location: Students on Accelerated Tuition (£40/month) can train at any location. Basic Tuition (£30/month) is for one location only.
membership_policies.upgrade: Students can upgrade from Basic to Accelerated at any time — contact Gavin on 07833 665905.
